prompt: A person lies prone on a rough bed, their body angled slightly away from a looming wall, struggling to breathe. The person’s face is drawn and pale, sweat clinging to their brow, their expression a mixture of pain and exhaustion. One hand clutches at their upper arm, where a stained cloth is pressed against a wound; a significant amount of crimson liquid pools beneath the person’s body. Above them, another figure—a guardian—kneels beside the bed, their face partially obscured, their hands pressing firmly against the person’s side, attempting to staunch the flow of crimson liquid. A yelping sound drifts in from the distance, overlaid with a shout. The room is dimly lit, the light filtering in from an unseen opening beyond the wall.
